newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss cabinet gives final okay for Holocaust fund.
newsitem.headline: Swiss cabinet gives final okay for Holocaust fund.

text.p: The Swiss government on Wednesday agreed to share control of a Holocaust humanitarian fund with major world Jewish groups, Foreign Minister Flavio Cotti said.
Cotti said the Federal Council, or cabinet, approved a decree setting up the fund on March 1 after talks this week on details of the fund with the World Jewish Congress (WJC).
"These talks led to a proposal for a solution which today was approved by the Federal Council," Cotti told reporters in Berne after a cabinet meeting.

The government agreed on February 12 to set up an organisation with Jewish groups to administer humanitarian aid to Holocaust survivors from a fund started by a donation of 100 million Swiss francs ($68.23 million) from swiss banks.

The decree sets up a board of seven directors, four of them "eminent personalities" from Switzerland and three to be named by the World Jewish Restitution Organisation (WJRO), an umbrella group of major Jewish organisations.
"The Federal Council will have overall supervision of the fund," the decree said.
